---
title: "Projects"
subtitle: "One project per study. Create, switch, back up or restore — sign in to keep projects in your account and open them on any computer."
---

```{=html}
<div id="tb-projects-page">
<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4 flex-wrap gap-2">
<div class="tb-demo-banner">
<i class="bi bi-info-circle text-accent"></i>
The bundled demo project — five KIIs and one FGD, each coded for Challenges, Causes and Impacts in a single reading — lets you explore every feature first.
</div>
<div class="d-flex gap-2">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="tb-import-project-btn"><i class="bi bi-upload"></i> Import Backup</button>
<input type="file" id="tb-import-project-file" accept=".json" class="d-none">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-accent" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#tb-modal-new-project"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg"></i> New Project</button>
</div>
</div>

<div id="tb-projects-list" class="grid gap-4"></div>
</div>

<!-- New Project Modal -->
<div class="modal fade" id="tb-modal-new-project" tabindex="-1">
<div class="modal-dialog">
<div class="modal-content">
<div class="modal-header"><h5 class="modal-title">New Project</h5><button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button></div>
<div class="modal-body">
<div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label" for="tbf-proj-title">Project Title</label><input class="form-control" id="tbf-proj-title" placeholder="e.g. Youth Employment Perceptions in Kilosa"></div>
<div class="mb-3"><label class="form-label" for="tbf-proj-description">Description</label><textarea class="form-control" id="tbf-proj-description" rows="2"></textarea></div>
<div class="grid gap-2 mb-3">
<div class="g-col-6"><label class="form-label" for="tbf-proj-topic">Research Topic</label><input class="form-control" id="tbf-proj-topic"></div>
<div class="g-col-6"><label class="form-label" for="tbf-proj-date">Date</label><input type="date" class="form-control" id="tbf-proj-date"></div>
</div>
<div class="grid gap-2 mb-3">
<div class="g-col-6"><label class="form-label" for="tbf-proj-researcher">Researcher</label><input class="form-control" id="tbf-proj-researcher"></div>
<div class="g-col-6"><label class="form-label" for="tbf-proj-org">Organization</label><input class="form-control" id="tbf-proj-org"></div>
</div>
<div class="form-check form-switch">
<input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="tbf-proj-weighting" checked>
<label class="form-check-label" for="tbf-proj-weighting">Enable 1–10 importance weighting</label>
</div>
</div>
<div class="modal-footer">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Cancel</button>
<button type="button" class="btn btn-accent" id="tb-create-project-btn">Create Project</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () { window.TB.whenReady(function () {
  var TB = window.TB;
  if (TB.seedDemoIfNeeded) TB.seedDemoIfNeeded();

  function esc(s) { return TB.escapeHtml(s); }

  function render() {
    var activeId = TB.getActiveProjectId();
    var list = TB.listProjects();
    var el = document.getElementById("tb-projects-list");
    if (!list.length) {
      el.innerHTML = '<div class="g-col-12"><div class="card"><div class="card-body tb-empty-state"><i class="bi bi-folder-plus"></i>No projects yet — create one to get started.</div></div></div>';
      return;
    }
    el.innerHTML = list.map(function (p) {
      var project = TB.loadProject(p.id) || { sources: [], themes: [], codings: [] };
      var isDemo = p.id === TB.DEMO_PROJECT_ID;
      var top = TB.childThemes(project, null).length;
      var sync = TB.cloud ? TB.cloud.syncState(p.id) : null;
      var syncPill = sync === "cloud" ? '<span class="tb-meta-pill tb-sync-cloud"><i class="bi bi-cloud-check"></i>In your account</span>'
        : sync === "pending" ? '<span class="tb-meta-pill"><i class="bi bi-cloud-upload"></i>Saving to your account…</span>'
        : sync === "local" ? '<span class="tb-meta-pill"><i class="bi bi-hdd"></i>This browser only</span>' : "";
      return '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-xxl-4">' +
        '<div class="card step-card h-100"><div class="card-body d-flex flex-column">' +
        '<div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start gap-2 mb-1">' +
        '<h3 class="h5 mb-0 tb-project-title">' + esc(p.title) + "</h3>" +
        (p.id === activeId ? '<span class="badge bg-accent">Active</span>' : "") +
        "</div>" +
        (isDemo ? '<div class="mb-1"><span class="badge text-bg-light border">Demo content</span></div>' : "") +
        '<p class="text-muted small flex-grow-1 mt-2">' + esc(project.description || "") + "</p>" +
        '<div class="mb-2">' +
        '<span class="tb-meta-pill"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-text"></i>' + project.sources.length + " sources</span>" +
        '<span class="tb-meta-pill"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i>' + top + " themes · " + (project.themes.length - top) + " sub-themes</span>" +
        '<span class="tb-meta-pill"><i class="bi bi-bookmark-check"></i>' + project.codings.length + " coded refs</span>" +
        syncPill +
        "</div>" +
        '<p class="small text-muted mb-3"><i class="bi bi-person"></i> ' + esc(p.researcher || "—") + " · updated " + esc(TB.ui.relativeTime(p.updatedAt)) + "</p>" +
        '<div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-auto">' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary tb-open-btn" data-id="' + esc(p.id) + '">Open <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></button>' +
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary tb-export-btn" data-id="' + esc(p.id) + '" title="Export backup (.json)"><i class="bi bi-download"></i></button>' +
        (isDemo ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary tb-reset-demo-btn" title="Restore the demo to its original state"><i class="bi bi-arrow-counterclockwise"></i> Reset demo</button>' : "") +
        '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger tb-delete-btn" data-id="' + esc(p.id) + '" title="Delete"><i class="bi bi-trash"></i></button>' +
        "</div></div></div></div>";
    }).join("");

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll(".tb-open-btn"), function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        TB.setActiveProjectId(btn.getAttribute("data-id"));
        window.location.href = "index.html";
      });
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll(".tb-export-btn"), function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () { TB.exportUtil.exportProjectJSON(TB.loadProject(btn.getAttribute("data-id"))); });
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll(".tb-reset-demo-btn"), function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (!confirm("Reset the demo project? Any changes you made to it will be lost.")) return;
        TB.rebuildDemoProject();
        render();
        TB.ui.refreshShell();
      });
    });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll(".tb-delete-btn"), function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (!confirm("Delete this project? This cannot be undone.")) return;
        TB.deleteProject(btn.getAttribute("data-id"));
        render();
        TB.ui.refreshShell();
      });
    });
  }

  document.getElementById("tb-create-project-btn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var title = document.getElementById("tbf-proj-title").value.trim();
    if (!title) { alert("Enter a project title."); return; }
    var project = TB.createProject({
      title: title,
      description: document.getElementById("tbf-proj-description").value,
      topic: document.getElementById("tbf-proj-topic").value,
      date: document.getElementById("tbf-proj-date").value,
      researcher: document.getElementById("tbf-proj-researcher").value,
      org: document.getElementById("tbf-proj-org").value,
      weightingEnabled: document.getElementById("tbf-proj-weighting").checked
    });
    TB.setActiveProjectId(project.id);
    bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById("tb-modal-new-project")).hide();
    window.location.href = "workspace.html";
  });

  document.getElementById("tb-import-project-btn").addEventListener("click", function () {
    document.getElementById("tb-import-project-file").click();
  });
  document.getElementById("tb-import-project-file").addEventListener("change", function (e) {
    var file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    TB.exportUtil.importProjectJSON(file, function (err, project) {
      if (err) { alert("Could not import that file: " + err.message); return; }
      TB.setActiveProjectId(project.id);
      render();
      TB.ui.refreshShell();
    });
  });

  render();
  if (window.location.hash === "#new") new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById("tb-modal-new-project")).show();
}); });
</script>
```
